title: Kai Log entry
description: One line of the record chain. Hash rules: tools/chain.py. Field meanings: /codebook.

seq.description: Position in the chain, starting at 1

date.description: When the work or event happened (ISO 8601)

period.description: 0 = founding period; 1 = 2027 Q1; and so on

reconstructed.description: Written after the fact from evidence (Period 0 only)

summary.description: What happened, people by role only (R13)

human_gate.description: Who approved, by role, and how

outcome.description: done, failed, abandoned, redone, or done with a qualifier

misses.description: Errors and how they were caught (R6); 'none recorded' if none

human_minutes.description: Estimated by the person, at the time (R11)

evidence.description: Link or reference to the evidence (R10)

requested_by.description: For rule entries: who asked, by role (R2)

decision.description: For rule entries: what was decided

consent_recorded.description: Event: a participant's consent form was received (R12)

report_request.description: Event: a report request was received

setup_snapshot.description: Event: hashes of the AI setup at a period start (R21)
